desc: the layout editor lists the touch Spin Dash button (Spin Dash on, a ROM linked; a faked 16:9 phone sideways): dragged on its own 15 mm left and 10 mm up, chosen (its panel: Spin Dash, size, opacity, Hide, Reset), then Done; the layout saved with it (touch_layout.txt's "v4" line and its entry) and the game played with it there ($TTYD_TOUCH_EDIT_DO, Aurora built with TTYD_TOUCH_OVERLAY=ON; ui_shots: touch_835_ui.png mid-drag, touch_865_ui.png its panel, touch_920_ui.png after)
